results.title: Maharaja Hostel
results.overview: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.

results.title: Immortal She
results.overview: A strange woman attempts an extremely unorthodox escape method during a home intrusion.

results.title: Chappell Roan: Live at Lollapalooza Brasil
results.original_title: Chappell Roan: Live at Lollapalooza Brasil
results.overview: Chappell Roan performed in South America for the first time in 2026 as part of her ‘Visions of Damsels & Other Dangerous Things’ tour, which brought it to a spectacular close at Lollapalooza Brasil on March 21st, 2026 at the Autódromo de Interlagos in São Paulo, Brasil. As part of the festival line-up, Chappell Roan made a point of bringing her entire set and pet ‘Shigella’ from the tour for an enchanting and involving performance at the festival, further engaging the public with her lyrics, performance, charm and love shouted at the audience throughout the entire show.

results.title: It's How It Ends
results.overview: After being expelled from college, Owen returns home to disappointed parents and leaves in the middle of the night with his younger sister Mara, wandering the city and stumbling into unexpected encounters.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 6
results.overview: The sixth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 25, 2026, at EBARA WAVE Arena Ota in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and Yota Tsuji.

results.title: Entre Bestias
results.overview: Luis de la Isla, one of the biggest Spanish-speaking podcasters, sets out to interview Alfredo Chaparro, the controversial former president of a major media network, without being aware of all the problems that will come his way.

results.title: Detention
results.overview: When four high schoolers get “Saturday Detention”, they quickly realize things just got a whole lot worse when they discover what they thought was just a waste-of-time detention turns into a bit of a nightmare… Group Therapy!

results.title: Sol Summer
results.overview: A woman, healing from her family's wounds, recounts her past to a Deity before the world's coming judgment.

results.title: Play Room
results.overview: In this surreal queer rom-com, macho bouncer Alexei secretly attends a cruising hotspot, where his sexual experiences are played out as rounds of board games. After multiple unfulfilling encounters, he finds himself connecting with Josh, which forces him to finally confront the way he keeps these worlds apart.

results.title: The Crystal Planet
results.overview: 11-year-old Rea has recently moved to a distant planet in an outer-space colony where she discovers a mysterious animal cub while her father works in a factory that builds robotic creatures. With the help of her new friend Andy, she must protect the real cub from the factory’s ruthless owner, who intends to turn it into a robotic prototype.

results.title: Only What We Carry
results.overview: Set against the windswept coast of Normandy. Described as “a meditation on love, loss, and the quiet courage it takes to move forward”.

results.title: John Lennon: The Last Interview
results.overview: On December 8, 1980, Lennon and Yoko Ono sat down with a small radio crew in their New York apartment to promote the release of their album Double Fantasy. What followed was an unfiltered, wide-ranging discussion about music, politics, fatherhood, and life. Just hours later, Lennon was killed. The complete interview is presented for the first time, framed by reflections from those who were present, revealing a man at the height of his creative and personal powers, openly looking toward the future he would never see.

results.title: The Mentor
results.overview: She wants to forget her past but her new boss forces her to remember. Krissy, fresh out of prison, gets hired by a strict CEO named Portia. Soon, the mentorship turns into a game of revenge.

results.title: Sugar Beach
results.overview: A D1-bound valedictorian hiding an addiction risks her perfect cover for an intoxicating throuple

results.title: The Leaching
results.overview: After waking up on her father's isolated forest property with amnesia, Vivian must use her limited memory to piece together the nightmarish truth, all the while being tormented by the undead, a giant leech monster, and her "father."

results.title: Revolution's Daughter
results.overview: A deep dive into the lives and experiences of those impacted by the Fidel Castro era in Cuba.

results.title: Forever Night
results.overview: Leonard's quiet and lonely night on the sofa takes an unexpected turn - and lasts forever.
